description.zh-CN: 模特使用或手持商品的展示图；姿态和角度会变化，因此不贴回原商品像素。
description.en: Shows a model using or holding the product; poses and angles change, so the original product pixels are not pasted back.

prompt.prefix: lifestyle photo of a person naturally using or holding the product,
prompt.suffix: natural pose, realistic skin and hands, soft flattering light
prompt.negative: text, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, distorted product
